turns.text: Hello. I would like to book a tattoo with the artist, a black fern about 6 cm long on my forearm.

Thank you. The artist handles tattoo bookings personally, and I can't give a price or a date in chat. I've passed your idea to a colleague: a black fern, about 6 cm long, on your forearm. They will take over from here. If you'd like, send your availability and they will have it too.

rule.ro: Lucrările la comandă și programările pentru tatuaje le discută artista personal. Prin chat nu oferim prețuri și nici date.
rule.en: The artist answers commission and tattoo booking inquiries in person. The chat gives no price and no date.
